mutations.name: AA-raw-json
mutations.what: the prompt of a tool that is not local is the JSON of its arguments, not masked

mutations.name: AA-first-pass-only
mutations.what: the prompt of a tool that is not local is not masked as text once more

mutations.name: AA-no-secrets
mutations.what: the prompt of a tool that is not local does not know the registered secrets

mutations.name: AA-local-raw-json
mutations.what: the arguments of a local tool with no card of its own are the JSON of the arguments

mutations.name: AA-local-no-secrets
mutations.what: the arguments of a local tool with no card of its own do not know the registered secrets

mutations.name: AA-local-not-masked-after
mutations.what: the arguments of a local tool with no card of its own are not masked as a detail
